19-kdm6b-tcell-subcluster-abundance

Bicna Song

2026-08-20

This analysis quantifies the abundance of the 13 T-cell subclusters and tests their differential abundance across treatment conditions. The sccomp model uses biological samples as replicates and 41BB-L as the reference condition.

Setup

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(rprojroot)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Seurat)
  library(sccomp)
})

root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v5")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "downstream-analyses")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results", "tcell", "kdm6b")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots", "tcell", "kdm6b")

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "sccomp_helpers.R"))

Analysis parameters

input_file <- file.path(data_dir, params$input_rds)
ranking_file <- file.path(results_dir, params$ranking_tsv)
condition_levels <- params$condition_levels

missing_input_files <- c(input_file, ranking_file)[
  !file.exists(c(input_file, ranking_file))
]
if (length(missing_input_files) > 0) {
  stop("Missing input file(s): ", paste(missing_input_files, collapse = ", "))
}

Load data

tcell_obj <- readRDS(input_file)
kdm6b_ranking <- readr::read_tsv(ranking_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    subcluster = as.character(subcluster),
    tcell_subtype = dplyr::if_else(
      subcluster == "4",
      "Cycling / proliferating T cells",
      tcell_subtype
    )
  )

required_metadata <- c("sample", "condition", "seurat_clusters")
required_ranking_columns <- c(
  "subcluster", "tcell_subtype", "kdm6b_rank", "kdm6b_group"
)

stopifnot(all(required_metadata %in% colnames(tcell_obj@meta.data)))
stopifnot(all(required_ranking_columns %in% colnames(kdm6b_ranking)))

observed_conditions <- unique(as.character(tcell_obj$condition))
if (!setequal(observed_conditions, condition_levels)) {
  stop("The observed treatment conditions do not match condition_levels.")
}

observed_subclusters <- unique(as.character(tcell_obj$seurat_clusters))
if (!setequal(observed_subclusters, kdm6b_ranking$subcluster)) {
  stop("The ranking table and T-cell object contain different subclusters.")
}

subcluster_levels <- as.character(
  sort(as.integer(observed_subclusters))
)
tcell_obj$condition <- factor(
  as.character(tcell_obj$condition),
  levels = condition_levels
)
tcell_obj$seurat_clusters <- factor(
  as.character(tcell_obj$seurat_clusters),
  levels = subcluster_levels
)

sample_condition_check <- tcell_obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample, condition) %>%
  dplyr::count(sample, name = "n_conditions")
if (any(sample_condition_check$n_conditions != 1)) {
  stop("Each biological sample must map to exactly one condition.")
}

table(tcell_obj$seurat_clusters, tcell_obj$condition)

T-cell subcluster proportions

subcluster_proportions <- tcell_obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(condition, cell_group = seurat_clusters, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = n_cells / sum(n_cells)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

p_subcluster_proportions <- ggplot(
  subcluster_proportions,
  aes(x = condition, y = proportion, fill = cell_group)
) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = DiscretePalette(n = length(subcluster_levels))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Condition", y = "Proportion", fill = "Subcluster")

p_subcluster_proportions

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "tcell_subcluster_proportions_stacked_barplot.png"),
  plot = p_subcluster_proportions,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  bg = "white"
)

All tcell subcluster differential abundance

This model tests all 13 subclusters. B7H3, CD28-41BB, CD8-41BB, STOP, and tumor are each compared with the 41BB-L reference condition.

sccomp_tcell_subclusters <- run_sccomp_composition(
  obj = tcell_obj,
  cell_group_col = "seurat_clusters",
  condition_levels = condition_levels,
  analysis_label = "tcell_subcluster",
  output_suffix = "41BBL_baseline",
  reference_label = "41BB-L reference",
  results_dir = results_dir
)
## Reference condition for 41BB-L reference sccomp: 41BB-L 
## Cell group column used for analysis: seurat_clusters
tcell_subcluster_sccomp_result <- sccomp_tcell_subclusters$result
p_sccomp_tcell_subclusters <- tcell_subcluster_sccomp_result %>%
  sccomp::plot_1D_intervals(significance_statistic = "FDR")

p_sccomp_tcell_subclusters

ggsave(
  file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "tcell_subcluster_composition_sccomp_41BBL_baseline.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_sccomp_tcell_subclusters,
  width = 16,
  height = 9,
  bg = "white"
)

Kdm6b-high and Kdm6b-low subcluster patterns

This summary uses the individual-subcluster sccomp results. Intermediate subclusters are excluded from this presentation but remain included in the fitted compositional model. Effects and intervals are reoriented to report 41BB-L relative to each comparison condition.

kdm6b_high_low_sccomp <- tcell_subcluster_sccomp_result %>%
  dplyr::filter(parameter != "(Intercept)") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cell_group = as.character(cell_group),
    comparison_condition = sub("^condition", "", parameter)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    kdm6b_ranking %>%
      dplyr::select(
        cell_group = subcluster,
        tcell_subtype,
        kdm6b_rank,
        kdm6b_group
      ),
    by = "cell_group"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(kdm6b_group %in% c("Kdm6b-high", "Kdm6b-low")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    comparison = paste("41BB-L vs", comparison_condition),
    sccomp_reference_condition = "41BB-L",
    effect_41bbl_vs_condition = -c_effect,
    lower_41bbl_vs_condition = -c_upper,
    upper_41bbl_vs_condition = -c_lower,
    significant_direction = dplyr::case_when(
      c_FDR >= 0.05 ~ "Not significantly different",
      effect_41bbl_vs_condition > 0 ~ "Enriched in 41BB-L",
      effect_41bbl_vs_condition < 0 ~ paste("Enriched in", comparison_condition),
      TRUE ~ "Not significantly different"
    ),
    status_in_41bbl = dplyr::case_when(
      c_FDR >= 0.05 ~ "Not significantly different",
      effect_41bbl_vs_condition > 0 ~ "Enriched in 41BB-L",
      effect_41bbl_vs_condition < 0 ~ "Depleted in 41BB-L",
      TRUE ~ "Not significantly different"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    subcluster = cell_group,
    tcell_subtype,
    kdm6b_rank,
    kdm6b_group,
    comparison,
    comparison_condition,
    sccomp_reference_condition,
    effect_41bbl_vs_condition,
    lower_41bbl_vs_condition,
    upper_41bbl_vs_condition,
    c_pH0,
    c_FDR,
    significant_direction,
    status_in_41bbl,
    c_rhat,
    c_ess_bulk,
    c_ess_tail
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    kdm6b_group,
    kdm6b_rank,
    match(comparison_condition, condition_levels[-1])
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  kdm6b_high_low_sccomp,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "tcell_kdm6b_high_low_subcluster_differential_abundance.tsv"
  )
)

kdm6b_high_low_sccomp
## sccomp model
## ============
## 
## Model specifications:
##   Family: multi_beta_binomial 
##   Composition formula: ~condition 
##   Variability formula: ~1 
##   Inference method: pathfinder 
## 
## Data: Samples: 12   Cell groups: 13 
## 
## Column prefixes: c_ -> composition parameters  v_ -> variability parameters
## 
## Convergence diagnostics:
##   For each parameter, n_eff is the effective sample size and R_k_hat is the potential
##   scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, R_k_hat = 1).
## 
## # A tibble: 30 × 17
##    subcluster tcell_subtype                 kdm6b_rank kdm6b_group comparison   
##    <chr>      <chr>                              <dbl> <chr>       <chr>        
##  1 3          NK-like cytotoxic lymphocytes          1 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs B7…
##  2 3          NK-like cytotoxic lymphocytes          1 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs CD…
##  3 3          NK-like cytotoxic lymphocytes          1 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs CD…
##  4 3          NK-like cytotoxic lymphocytes          1 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs ST…
##  5 3          NK-like cytotoxic lymphocytes          1 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs tu…
##  6 9          γδ T cells                             2 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs B7…
##  7 9          γδ T cells                             2 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs CD…
##  8 9          γδ T cells                             2 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs CD…
##  9 9          γδ T cells                             2 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs ST…
## 10 9          γδ T cells                             2 Kdm6b-high  41BB-L vs tu…
## # ℹ 20 more rows
## # ℹ 12 more variables: comparison_condition <chr>,
## #   sccomp_reference_condition <chr>, effect_41bbl_vs_condition <dbl>,
## #   lower_41bbl_vs_condition <dbl>, upper_41bbl_vs_condition <dbl>,
## #   c_pH0 <dbl>, c_FDR <dbl>, significant_direction <chr>,
## #   status_in_41bbl <chr>, c_rhat <dbl>, c_ess_bulk <dbl>, c_ess_tail <dbl>
subcluster_label_levels <- kdm6b_ranking %>%
  dplyr::filter(kdm6b_group %in% c("Kdm6b-high", "Kdm6b-low")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(kdm6b_group, kdm6b_rank) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    label = paste0("Cluster ", subcluster, ": ", tcell_subtype)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(label)

kdm6b_high_low_plot_data <- kdm6b_high_low_sccomp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    kdm6b_group = factor(
      kdm6b_group,
      levels = c("Kdm6b-high", "Kdm6b-low")
    ),
    comparison = factor(
      comparison,
      levels = paste("41BB-L vs", condition_levels[-1])
    ),
    subcluster_label = factor(
      paste0("Cluster ", subcluster, ": ", tcell_subtype),
      levels = rev(subcluster_label_levels)
    ),
    significance_label = ifelse(c_FDR < 0.05, "*", "")
  )

p_kdm6b_high_low_enrichment <- ggplot(
  kdm6b_high_low_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = comparison,
    y = subcluster_label,
    fill = effect_41bbl_vs_condition
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey85") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance_label), size = 5) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(kdm6b_group),
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "sccomp effect\n(41BB-L vs comparison)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Comparison",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "* FDR < 0.05. Positive (red): enriched in 41BB-L;",
      "negative (blue): enriched in the comparison condition."
    )
  ) +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey70")
  )

p_kdm6b_high_low_enrichment

ggsave(
  file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "tcell_kdm6b_high_low_subcluster_enrichment_across_conditions.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_kdm6b_high_low_enrichment,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  bg = "white"
)
